name: code-art-workflow
description: Makes short videos and vector drawings by having an AI write code: a video skill (Remotion, with a plain-browser renderer as fallback) and an SVG skill, on shared tools for rendering, encoding, checking clips, parity of SVG renderers, palettes, outlined text and tracing. Figure steps use fleet:codex-imagegen where the fleet plugin is installed; without fleet, a piece supplies its figures another way.
